name: Camping Riffler
beschreibung: Camping Riffler is located in Landeck in the district of Landeck in the Tyrolean Oberland, about 500 metres west of the town centre on the Sanna river. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as simple sanitary facilities. Guests can reach the village center and the ski slope in just a few minutes. The atmosphere is quiet and family-friendly, with direct access to hiking trails and ski slopes.
